backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/listings.rs:289 — public search handler surfaces raw sqlx::Error via format!("Failed to search listings: {}", e); same at :301 for count_listings. Inconsistent with the same file's get_listing (line 344-348) and get_categories (line 800-806) which explicitly hide DB error text with a generic 'Internal server error' and log the detail server-side. Publicly reachable (unauthenticated /api/v1/listings), so a query-provoked DB error can leak pool state / connection-string fragments / migration hints to arbitrary internet clients.

backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/users.rs:459-463 — request_password_reset logs the raw plaintext_token at tracing::info! level under #[cfg(debug_assertions)]. Release builds are safe, but any debug binary deployed to dev/staging (a common misconfiguration) writes a valid password-reset token into the log stream. Anyone with log-aggregator read access can then reset any account whose email hits the endpoint. Consider gating on an explicit env-var (DEV_LOG_RESET_TOKEN=1) or dropping the token from the message entirely and printing it only to stdout of the test harness.

backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/sso.rs:665 — generate_code_verifier uses .expect("OS rng failed") on rand::rngs::SysRng.try_fill_bytes; same pattern at backend/servers/reality-server/src/handlers/users/mod.rs:551 in request_password_reset. Both sit on user-triggerable request paths (SSO login init, portal password reset). An OS RNG failure would panic the tokio task and return a bare 500 to the client instead of a mapped error. Preferred: map to StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR with a tracing::error! so the failure is observable rather than an unwind through the axum handler.
